about: Changes to the firmware's own QML that Qt 5.15 needs where the Toon's Qt 5.11 was more lenient. tools/build_compat.py applies them to the files in firmware/*.rcc and builds firmware/compat.rcc, which toonsim loads before the firmware, so the patched file takes the original's place at the same qrc: address. Each patch replaces an exact text; a patch whose text is no longer in the file (a new firmware) is reported and skipped.

patches.replace: // signal clicked;  (toonsim: StyledRectangle already has clicked; Qt 5.15 rejects redeclaring it)
patches.why: Qt 5.15: 'Duplicate signal name: invalid override of property change signal or superclass signal'
